data:
It's 10:30 PM and I'm about to go to sleep. Tomorrow I'll wake up at 5:30 AM to go to the hospital for the first dose of the first cycle of six.

I'll be receiving Gemcitabine and Oxaliplatin for the first time. The immunotherapy is still pending insurance approval; once it's approved, I'll start taking it, maybe from the next cycle.

Reflection

This week, Mimi and I have been feeling Jehovah's peace. We also received some practical advice during a spiritual meeting:

  • Seek professional help.
  • Build healthy habits.
  • Get help from friends.
  • Stay positive.

You can read more about these points here.

Into your hand I entrust my spirit.
You have redeemed me, O Jehovah, the God of truth.

— Psalm 31:5
